title: Presidential-cycle in/out rules on TAIEX, TSMC and 0050 — none beats buy-and-hold; skipping the midterm year comes closest and missed 2026
question: Run as in/out strategies with costs, do presidential-cycle timing rules beat buy-and-hold on TAIEX, TSMC and 0050?
hypothesis: Being out of Taiwan equities during the weak part of the cycle raises return or lowers drawdown against buy-and-hold.

findings.title: Buy-and-hold wins on all three
findings.detail: CAGR 2001–2026: TAIEX 9.12% (price only), TSMC 20.65%; 0050 21.22% from 2014. No timing rule exceeds it.
findings.title_zh: 三個標的都是一直持有最好

findings.title: Skipping the midterm year comes closest
findings.detail: TAIEX 8.51%, TSMC 20.40% with max drawdown −46.5% against −59.8%; beat buy-and-hold in 3 of 6 and 2 of 6 cycles, mean excess not separable (bounds 25 and 62 points). Out through 2026, when TAIEX rose about 63%.
findings.title_zh: 跳過期中選舉年最接近
findings.detail_zh: 加權 8.51%、台積電 20.40%，台積電最大回檔 −46.5% 對 −59.8%；分別在 6 輪中贏 3 輪、2 輪，平均差異無法分辨。2026 年空手，期間加權漲約 63%。

findings.title: Out from March of the pre-election year costs
findings.detail: TAIEX 7.77%, TSMC 17.08%, 0050 18.90% CAGR; beat buy-and-hold in 2 of 6, 2 of 6, 0 of 2 cycles.
findings.title_zh: 選前一年 3 月出場會少賺

findings.title: Half-time windows trail by 3–17 CAGR points
findings.detail: Holding only 27–50% of the time loses more to the market's drift than it saves in bad years.
findings.title_zh: 只持有一半時間的規則落後 3–17 個百分點
findings.detail_zh: 只在 27–50% 的時間持有，少賺的上漲多於避開的下跌。

card_summary: As in/out strategies with Taiwan costs, no presidential-cycle rule beats buy-and-hold on TAIEX, TSMC or 0050. Skipping the midterm year comes closest and cuts TSMC's worst drawdown, but missed 2026's rally. 6 cycles; nothing separates.
title_zh: 台股照總統週期進出（加權、台積電、0050）：沒有一種規則贏過一直持有；跳過期中選舉年最接近，但錯過 2026
question_zh: 把總統週期做成進出場規則、算進台股交易成本後，能不能贏過一直持有加權、台積電或 0050？
hypothesis_zh: 避開週期中較弱的時段，報酬或回檔會比一直持有好。
card_summary_zh: 算進台股交易成本後，沒有一種總統週期進出規則贏過一直持有加權、台積電或 0050。跳過期中選舉年最接近、也減少台積電的最大回檔，但錯過 2026 年的大漲。只有 6 個週期，差異無法分辨。
limitations_zh: 6 個完整週期（0050 只有 2 個），差異無法分辨。
加權為價格指數（不含每年約 3–4% 股息），對持有現金的規則有利；現金 0%。
台灣大選和美國大選同年，無法分開兩種日曆。
Yahoo 資料；0050 2014 年前資料有誤而排除；台積電有成交量為 0 的元旦資料列，影響可忽略。
interpretation_zh: 把總統週期做成台股進出規則並計入成本，沒有一種贏過一直持有。進出的代價是少了持有時間：台股長期上漲，空手錯過的漲幅多於避開的下跌。要降低風險，應該調整配置，而不是擇時進出。
